controles.affirmation: A l'echelle du semestre, le resultat operationnel CONSOLIDE est meme negatif a -3,95 M$, contre +96,3 M$ un an plus tot, avant les ajustements AOI.
controles.verbatim_source: Compte de resultat consolide, six mois clos le 30 juin : 'Operating income 521,917 / 486,653 / 151,401 / 601,422' (T2 2026, T2 2025, S1 2026, S1 2025). Les chiffres (3,954) et 96,311 proviennent de la table 'Segment Operating Results — Concerts', pas du consolide.
controles.correction_proposee: Le resultat operationnel consolide du S1 2026 est POSITIF a 151,4 M$ (contre 601,4 M$ au S1 2025). Les -3,95 M$ vs +96,3 M$ sont le resultat operationnel du SEGMENT CONCERTS. Reecrire : 'le segment Concerts bascule en perte operationnelle sur le semestre, a -3,95 M$ contre +96,3 M$ un an plus tot'.

controles.affirmation: L'approbation Say-on-pay n'a recueilli que 74 % des voix lors de l'assemblee generale de juin 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: DEF14A depose le 24 avril 2026 : 'At our 2025 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, approximately 74% of the votes cast (excluding abstentions and broker non-votes) were in favor of our say-on-pay proposal.' et 'At the 2025 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, a large majority (73.8%) of the votes cast ... were for the advisory proposal'.
controles.correction_proposee: Le vote a 74 % (73,8 %) est celui de l'assemblee generale 2025. Le proxy est publie AVANT l'AG du 11 juin 2026 et ne peut pas contenir le resultat de cette AG. Ecrire : 'lors de l'assemblee generale 2025'.

controles.affirmation: Preuve citee : 'Concerts AOI margin 4.8% ... (14%)' pour justifier 'marge AOI de seulement 4,8 %, en baisse de 20 % sur un an'.
controles.verbatim_source: Table Concerts : 'AOI $ 309,554 / $ 358,682 / (14)%' puis 'AOI margin 4.8% / 6.0%'. Le (14)% porte sur l'AOI en dollars, pas sur la marge.
controles.correction_proposee: La baisse de 20 % est un calcul derive (4,8 % vs 6,0 %), non un chiffre du document. Citer separement : 'AOI margin 4.8% contre 6.0%' et ne pas accoler le '(14%)' qui designe la variation de l'AOI en valeur.

controles.affirmation: Hook : 'un jury federal a rendu son verdict contre l'entreprise dans le proces antitrust du gouvernement americain'.
controles.verbatim_source: 'Early in the trial, the Company entered into a binding term sheet with the United States settling the lawsuit' ; 'The remaining states and District of Columbia (the Litigating States) proceeded to trial. On April 15, 2026, the jury returned a verdict for the Litigating States on all claims that remained, including an award of damages measured on a per-ticket-sold basis, BUT WITHOUT CALCULATING THE NUMBER OF TICKETS TO WHICH THE DAMAGES WOULD BE APPLIED.'
controles.correction_proposee: Le gouvernement federal avait deja transige avant le verdict : le verdict a ete rendu en faveur des ETATS plaignants, pas des Etats-Unis. Ajouter aussi que le jury n'a PAS chiffre le nombre de billets, donc le montant des dommages n'est pas etabli.

controles.affirmation: Charge de 450 M$ comptabilisee au titre du proces antitrust au S1 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: As a result of the damages verdict, we have recognized $ 450 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, within Corporate expenses which represents our best estimate of the ultimate loss associated with the Settling States and the jury's damages award.

controles.affirmation: En mai 2024, le DOJ et vingt-neuf Etats ont depose une plainte antitrust demandant notamment la cession de Ticketmaster ; en mars 2026 reglement avec le gouvernement federal et six Etats ; l'entreprise conteste par requetes post-proces et envisage un appel devant la Cour d'appel du deuxieme circuit.
controles.verbatim_source: 'together with the attorneys general of twenty-nine states plus the District of Columbia' ; 'The Complaint requested various forms of relief ... including without limitation the divestiture of Ticketmaster by the Company' ; 'The terms of the Settlement, which were made public on March 9, 2026' ; 'six additional states (the Settling States) also settled' ; 'The Company raised those issues and others in post-trial motions at the district court which are scheduled for argument on July 31, 2026. As needed and in due course, the Company intends to file an appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit.'
controles.correction_proposee: Detail : ajouter 'plus le District de Columbia' aux vingt-neuf Etats.

controles.affirmation: Tunney Act : le reglement doit encore etre approuve par le juge federal ; phase 'remedies' distincte encore a trancher.
controles.verbatim_source: Under the Tunney Act, the district court judge presiding over the matter must approve the settlement before it takes final effect ; ... a 'remedies' phase in which the Litigating States will propose and the Court will assess equitable remedies the plaintiffs have sought, including among others those enumerated above, as well as civil penalties under certain state laws.

controles.affirmation: Plainte FTC de septembre 2025 avec sept Etats sur des prix affiches trompeusement inferieurs et la revente de billets acquis illegalement ; requete en rejet deposee en janvier 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: In September 2025, the United States Federal Trade Commission (the FTC), joined by the attorneys general of seven states ... The plaintiffs allege that Live Nation and Ticketmaster advertised ticket prices to consumers that were deceptively lower than prices displayed at checkout ... and facilitated the sale of tickets unlawfully acquired by ticket brokers ... The Company filed a motion to dismiss the complaint in January 2026.

controles.verbatim_source: Total Live Nation stockholders' equity 82,330 ; Total equity 755,563 ; Total liabilities and equity $ 28,180,826 ; Total debt, net of unamortized discounts and debt issuance costs 9,201,465 (contre 6,476,348 au 30 juin 2025, soit +42,1 %) ; cash 9,071,949 ; Net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders of Live Nation $ ( 94,658 ) / $ 266,614.
